shell.promoDescription: Nâng trình ngoại ngữ của bạn cùng Trellis LMS.
shell.studioPromoDescription: Soạn, sắp xếp và xuất bản nội dung học tập với Trellis LMS.

dashboard.title: Tổng quan
dashboard.intro: Tiếp tục hành trình ngoại ngữ của bạn: xây kỹ năng, theo dõi tiến độ và đạt mục tiêu cùng Trellis.

catalog.title: Danh mục khoá học
catalog.description: Khám phá các khoá tiếng Anh và tiếng Trung cho mọi mục tiêu, từ giao tiếp hằng ngày tới học thuật.
catalog.searchPlaceholder: Tìm khoá học (ví dụ: tiếng Anh thương mại, HSK, luyện nói)
catalog.emptyTitle: Không có khoá học nào khớp bộ lọc
catalog.emptyDescription: Bỏ bớt một bộ lọc hoặc tìm chủ đề khác.

goals.completeAllLessons: Hoàn thành toàn bộ bài học
goals.holdConversation: Nói được hội thoại hằng ngày đơn giản
goals.takeQuiz: Làm bài kiểm tra cuối khoá

player.videoPlaceholder: Video bài học sẽ phát ở đây trong ứng dụng thật.
player.overviewBody: Bài học này giới thiệu khoá học, cách nội dung được sắp xếp và bạn sẽ làm được gì sau khi học xong.
player.qnaEmptyDescription: Hỏi giảng viên bất cứ điều gì trong bài học này.

studio.comingSoonDescription: Bản dựng này mới làm tab Nội dung.

home.title: My Courses
home.description: Courses you own, newest change first.
home.versions: {count, plural, =0 {No published version} one {# version} other {# versions}}
home.learners: {count, plural, =0 {No learners} one {# learner} other {# learners}}
home.emptyTitle: You have not created a course yet
home.emptyDescription: Start a draft; nothing is visible to learners until you publish it.

draft.title: New course
draft.description: A draft is private. Choose a level framework now, because the two scales do not convert into each other.
draft.titlePlaceholder: For example: Chinese II — Daily Life
draft.frameworkNote: CEFR and the Chinese curriculum are separate scales. A course declares one, and levels never map across.
draft.summaryPlaceholder: One or two sentences a learner reads before enrolling.
draft.levelRequired: Choose a level on the selected framework.

detailsTab.title: Course details
detailsTab.lockedNote: A published version is a snapshot learners are already on. Change these on a new version instead.

settingsTab.title: Settings
settingsTab.note: Settings apply to the draft. Publishing copies them into the new version.

preflight.title: Publish
preflight.description: Everything below has to pass before a version can be cut.
preflight.blockedDescription: {count, plural, one {# check needs attention} other {# checks need attention}} before this course can go out.
preflight.pendingNote: A check that is still running blocks publishing too: an unscanned file cannot be served.

checks.assessmentsPublished: Assessments used by this course are published

questionBank.title: Question bank
questionBank.description: Questions are versioned. Once an assessment cites a revision, that revision stops changing.
questionBank.frozenNote: Used by {assessments}. Editing would change what graded attempts were marked against, so this makes a new revision instead.
questionBank.notUsed: Not used by any assessment yet
questionBank.emptyDescription: Clear the search, or add the first question.

assessmentAuthor.title: Assessment
assessmentAuthor.description: Pick question revisions, set the policy, then publish. Publishing freezes everything it cites.
assessmentAuthor.emptySelectionDescription: Add a question revision from the bank on the right.
assessmentAuthor.summary: {count, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}} · {points} points
assessmentAuthor.unversionedNote: Publishing stamps a revision on this policy, so a grade can always name the rules it was produced under.

assessment.instructions: Đọc kỹ từng câu và chọn một đáp án. Câu trả lời được lưu trong lúc bạn làm bài.
assessment.selectHint: Chọn đáp án đúng nhất. Bạn có thể đổi lựa chọn trước khi nộp.
assessment.navigatorDescription: Nhảy tới câu bất kỳ và xem lại đáp án trước khi nộp.
assessment.footerNote: Thiết kế để tập trung làm bài. Trong bản dựng này, đáp án chỉ lưu cục bộ.

revealPolicies.afterFinalize: Answers shown after your attempt is graded
revealPolicies.afterClose: Answers shown after the assessment closes

lock.passScore: Score at least {score}% on “{lesson}” to open this lesson.
lock.title: This lesson is not open yet

landing.title: Course
landing.outcomesTitle: What you will be able to do
landing.outlineNote: Lesson titles are public; the lessons themselves open once you enrol.
landing.alreadyEnrolled: You are enrolled in this course.
landing.noOpenEditionTitle: No edition is open right now
landing.noOpenEditionDescription: This course runs in cohorts. Check back when the next edition opens.
landing.signedOutNote: You are viewing the public page. Enrolling asks you to sign in.

enrol.title: Enrol in {course}
enrol.description: You will join {edition} and stay on course version {version} even after a newer one is published.
enrol.created: You are enrolled. The first lesson is ready.
enrol.alreadyEnrolled: You were already enrolled — this did not create a second enrolment.
enrol.editionClosed: This edition is closed. Pick another edition.
enrol.policyNote: Enrolment is free for this edition; payment is out of scope for now.

myCourses.title: My Courses
myCourses.description: Everything you are enrolled in, newest activity first.
myCourses.emptyTitle: You are not enrolled in anything yet
myCourses.emptyDescription: Browse the catalog and join a course to see it here.

attemptStart.title: Before you start
attemptStart.serverTimeNote: The clock runs on the server. Closing the tab does not pause it.
attemptStart.historyEmpty: You have not attempted this yet.
attemptStart.resumeNote: You have an attempt in progress. Starting again continues that one instead of creating a new attempt.
attemptStart.noAttemptsLeftDescription: You have used all {total} attempts. Ask your instructor if you need another.
attemptStart.expiredDescription: It ran past the time limit and was not submitted, so it does not count towards your grade.
attemptStart.proposedNote: These rules follow the proposed defaults and are not approved yet.

result.title: Result
result.gradingDescription: Marking is still running. The score appears here when it finishes.
result.revisionNote: Both are frozen, so re-running the grade gives the same result.
result.feedbackHidden: Feedback opens once every attempt is finalised.
result.pendingNote: An instructor marks this answer by hand.
result.adjustmentsNote: Adjustments are added, never edited, so the original mark stays on record.
result.historyNote: Your grade uses the {rule}, so it does not always follow the latest attempt.
result.duplicateSubmitNote: You submitted this attempt twice. The second submission returned the grade that already existed.

submitConfirm.title: Submit this attempt?
submitConfirm.description: You have answered {answered} of {total} questions. Submitting ends the attempt and starts grading.

complete.blocked: Open the lesson before marking it complete.
complete.note: Completion is recorded on the server; your progress may take a moment to catch up.
